employeeWorkHours.caption: Calculate holiday entitlement
employeeWorkHours.heading: Does the employee work irregular hours or for part of the year?
employeeWorkHours.hint: ‘Irregular hours’ means the number of hours an employee works in a pay period often or always changes. ‘Part of the year’ means there are periods of at least a week in a leave year where the employee does not need to work and is not paid.
